rektion: jdm./einer Sache (Dat.) widersprechen; sich (Dat.) widersprechen (= Widersprüchliches sagen)
definition_de: sagen, dass man anderer Meinung ist oder dass etwas nicht stimmt (dem Chef widersprechen); sich widersprechen = zwei Dinge sagen, die nicht zusammenpassen. Nur untrennbar.
example_de: Beim Abendessen widerspricht Lena ihrem Opa, als er behauptet, früher sei alles besser gewesen.
example_en: At dinner Lena contradicts her grandpa when he claims that everything used to be better.
visual_idea: Collocation 'jdm. widersprechen' at a family dinner: the grandfather holds forth with a raised fork, and his teenage granddaughter shakes her head and raises her index finger with a confident smile, while the parents watch amused. The head shake plus raised finger read as 'no, that's not right'. Rejected: contradicting the boss in a meeting (too close to the unterstellen card) and a TV debate (studio graphics attract text).
image_prompt: a warm German family dinner table in the evening, an elderly grandfather at the head of the table talks with conviction and a raised fork, opposite him his teenage granddaughter shakes her head with a confident smile and raises her index finger to disagree, her parents between them watch amused, plates with potatoes and salad, warm lamp light, medium wide shot
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: at a family dinner a grandfather talks with a raised fork; his teenage granddaughter shakes her head, raises her index finger and answers him calmly, and the parents exchange an amused look; static medium wide shot
